# requireSpreadsheet

<link-summary>Returns the value as a spreadsheet, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireSpreadsheet() — Returns the value as a spreadsheet, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireSpreadsheet(
  value: unknown,
  message: string = "Required Spreadsheet object is missing or invalid."
): GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Spreadsheet;
```

An Apps Script service object has no constructor a script can test against, so the guard reads the tag the object reports for itself: `value.toString() === "Spreadsheet"`. A plain object that reports the same tag passes too, which in practice means a test double.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter                                                                       | Type      | Description                                                   |
| :------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`                                                                         | `unknown` | The value to validate.                                        |
| `message` _(optional)_ `= "Required Spreadsheet object is missing or invalid."` | `string`  | The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Spreadsheet` — the same value, typed as a spreadsheet.

## Throws

| Exception                     | Condition                       |
| :---------------------------- | :------------------------------ |
| `InvalidSpreadsheetException` | the value is not a spreadsheet. |

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
const spreadsheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActive();

requireSpreadsheet(spreadsheet); // => spreadsheet
requireSpreadsheet({}); // throws InvalidSpreadsheetException
requireSpreadsheet(null); // throws InvalidSpreadsheetException
```
